About this Dashboard:


A set of financial charts that demonstrate the past and potential future revenues, alongside the cash generation position for the company. The information presented should be used to review  progress against plan, and the likely outcome for quarter/year measured against the planned targets.


Revenue Trend by BU

The historic and forecast revenue by month.


The information provided in the chart and underlying report shows the breakdown of revenues by product/service line and highlights which areas are showing the most demand.


Bookings Pipeline v. Target

The likely amounts of sales bookings generated each month based on the total contract value (note - the revenue earned from a sale will have a different profile to the bookings pipeline).


The total Possible booking value gives an indicator of the effectiveness of the sales engine and the likely coverage vs. target. Ideally, the Possible amount is greater than or equal to the target, for the near term months, and is likely to drop below for the months further out.


Projected Cash-In (6+6)

The historic and forecast value of invoices to be raised by month based on sold business.


The forecast invoice value, combined with typical payment terms, will provide an accurate forecast for the cashflow-in (product & services) part of a cashflow forecast.
